connection_type: I'm an interested observer — no direct personal connection
disclosure_text: I am an observer to topics like immigration and religion but have no strong connections to either.
micronarrative: I connect with the side handing out tea and fighting for immigrant rights. I have lived in the US my whole life. I don't have immigrant parents, but at some point in all our genealogy our families came here from other countries and I will never be angry at an "outsider" for wanting to come in. I grew up in a blue collar town and went to a public high school. There were poor kids and not too many rich kids. Seeing diversity in that way made me realize all people deserve to be here. Its good to speak to all levels. You realize how much people are alike! It helps me work as part of a team. There are many different personalities and lifestyles at play, and you have to treat everyone fairly.
